{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Check for the presence of 'new' in customer_segment
print("Unique customer_segment values:", sales['customer_segment'].unique())

# Check for the presence of 'paid_search' in channel
print("Unique channel values:", sales['channel'].unique())

# Check the converted column
print("Converted column values and counts:\n", sales['converted'].value_counts())

# Check if any rows have revenue = 999999.99 (QA orders)
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"Number of QA orders: {len(qa_orders)}")

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_orders = sales[sales['status'] == 'refunded']
print(f"Number of refunded orders: {len(refunded_orders)}")

# Check for sentinel values in customer_age
sentinel_age = sales[sales['customer_age'] == -1]
print(f"Number of customers with age = -1: {len(sentinel_age)}")

# Check if revenue is string with commas
print("Sample of revenue values:", sales['revenue'].head(10).tolist())"}
